name: Enrique Mateo Cobo
headline: I design and build machines and software end to end.
intro: Mechatronics engineering student at KIT. My projects go from a hand sketch and Fusion 360 CAD to working hardware on my desk, and to an iOS app live on the App Store.

heroImage.alt: KMI 2.0, the CoreXY 3D printer I designed and built on an aluminium-extrusion frame

heroCaption: KMI 2.0 · CoreXY 3D printer, designed and built from scratch

stats.label: iOS app on the App Store

about: I like starting from a blank sheet of graph paper and ending with something that moves, prints, or ships. Most of my builds start as a pencil sketch, move into Fusion 360, and are then printed, wired and tested at my desk.

I treat constraints as part of the design: the printer had a hard €120 budget, so I recycled the mainboard from my old Creality and only bought what I truly needed. When something fails, I rebuild it better. The first printed frame flexed, so version two moved to aluminium extrusion.
